{"id":1071051177,"question_id":264,"lang":"csharp","lang_name":"C#","time":"2 years, 9 months","timestamp":1696866887,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"23 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1071051177/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Ugly Number II","memory":"27.4 MB","code":"public class Solution {\n    public int NthUglyNumber(int n) {\n        if(n==1)\n            return n;\n        int t2  = 0, t3 = 0, t5 = 0;\n        int[] ans = new int[n];\n        ans[0] = 1;\n        for(int i =1; i < n; i++)\n        {\n            ans[i] = Math.Min(ans[t2] * 2 , Math.Min(ans[t3] * 3,ans[t5] * 5));\n            if(ans[i] == ans[t2] * 2)\n            {\n                t2++;\n            }\n             if(ans[i] == ans[t3] * 3)\n            {\n                t3++;\n            }\n             if(ans[i] == ans[t5] * 5)\n            {\n                t5++;\n            }\n        }\n        return ans[n-1];\n    }\n}","compare_result":"","title_slug":"ugly-number-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":163}
